name: RD-SYN qPCR A and B synthetic evidence journey

messages.content: Compare fictional RD-SYN qPCR A and B for 96 wells, 6 detection channels, up to 6 multiplex targets, an audit-trail capability, and a JPY 6,000,000 ceiling. Use all four WebMCP tools, compare specifications using the same field names and units, check fictional JPY price records without mixing pricing conditions, and report device-name mention counts from twelve fictional research records, with sources and limitations.
